deviationScope: SORT4CIRC native JSON/XML serialisation does not implement the EN 18223 common-model serialisations.
reason: Open pending a validated field-level mapping, Clause 5 and Annex A/B artefacts, and an approved decision.

consequences.conformity: Full EN 18223 conformity and presumption of conformity through EN 18223 are not claimed while this deviation is open.
consequences.exploitation: Interoperability must rely on the documented SORT4CIRC mapping until the deviation is resolved.
